desc: List third-party app MCP servers approved for an organization, derived from the org's MCP server allowlist. Entries reflect allowlist state, not install/scope liveness: servers of apps that are uninstalled (but not deleted) are still listed.

token.desc: Authentication token bearing required scopes. Tokens should be passed as an HTTP Authorization header or alternatively, as a POST parameter.

limit.desc: The maximum number of items to return. Must be between 1 - 1000 both inclusive.

cursor.desc: Set `cursor` to `next_cursor` returned by the previous call to list items in the next page

server_id.desc: Encoded ID of the MCP server

url.desc: The URL of the MCP server

auth_type.desc: The authentication type for the MCP server

app_id.desc: Encoded ID of the app that provides this MCP server

app_name.desc: Name of the app that provides this MCP server

restricted_action.desc: User does not have permission to perform this action.

invalid_cursor.desc: Value passed for `cursor` was not valid or is no longer valid.

not_an_enterprise.desc: This feature is only available on Enterprise Grid plans.

feature_not_enabled.desc: The MCP server admin API feature is not enabled for this team.
